answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. By the nectar of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the whisper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the comet of the next round.
